apps.name: Decantra
apps.subtitle: Procedural bottle-sorting puzzle game
apps.localizedDescription: Decantra is a bottle-sorting puzzle game with procedurally generated levels that never run out. Sort the colored liquids by pouring from one bottle to another until each bottle holds a single color. Pour by dragging one bottle onto another. You can only pour onto the same color or into an empty bottle. Black bottles, or sinks, accept liquid but cannot be picked up, requiring careful planning. A level is solved when every non-empty bottle contains exactly one color. Early levels ease you in, while later levels introduce more colors, varying bottle sizes, and multiple sinks.

apps.name: Dieter
apps.subtitle: Workspace for coding agents on your machines
apps.localizedDescription: Dieter runs coding agents (Codex, Claude Code, Pi, Oh My Pi, DeepSeek Harness) on your own computers. A daemon starts each agent beside your Git checkout with your tools and provider accounts, keeping it alive when you close the app or sleep your laptop. Native apps unify boards, conversations, files, terminals, and screens across machines so you can start a task on a Mac, run it on a Linux workstation, and review results from your phone. Check out the same project on multiple hosts; each conversation runs on the machine you choose. Review files, Git changes, terminals, background processes, and an authenticated remote screen next to the conversation.

A companion mobile app (iOS/iPadOS + Android) is also available, covering the main BEQ workflow against an existing ezbeq server.

Full documentation, including this README, is also published at.

Windows / MacOS:

Python is required so use an appropriate package manager to install it.

chocolatey is a convenient choice for Windows.

Linux:

Use your distro package manager to install python.

Running in Docker:

Set EZBEQ_ACCESS_LOG_STDOUT=1 in your container environment to echo every HTTP request to stdout so it appears in docker compose logs. This is independent of accessLogging: in ezbeq.yml (which controls the access log file).

apps.localizedDescription:
🔥 FlameLauncher for iOS:

Run Minecraft: Java Edition on iPhone and iPad.

• What it does:.

This is Java Edition, not Bedrock. Join the servers your PC friends use, run the mods they run. A real OpenJDK boots inside the app process — this is not an emulator.

Graphics:

The renderer is per-instance. Shaders require MobileGlues.

Controls:

• On-screen buttons — you place and size them yourself.
• Hardware keyboard — picked up as soon as it connects.
• Gamepad — sticks and triggers included.
• In-game menu — change resolution and hotbar size while playing.

Multiplayer:

Ordinary servers, plus Online LAN for playing with a friend without renting a server: open a room, share the code, they join with it.

versions.localizedDescription:

• FlameJIT, a small companion app that turns JIT on for you. Install it next to FlameLauncher and the launcher hands it the process, the pairing file and the JIT script over a URL; it attaches and returns. No picking the app in StikDebug, no re-selecting a script after every reinstall.…

About:

Flixor is a modern, cross-platform Plex client that brings a Netflix-like experience to your media library. Browse beautiful rows, see rich metadata with ratings from multiple sources, and enjoy powerful playback on any device.

Core Experience:

• Netflix-style UI - Continue Watching, Trending, Collections, Watchlist, and more.
• Rich metadata - Trailers, cast info, tech badges (4K/HDR/Atmos/DTS-X).
• Smart search - Search across Plex and TMDB with intelligent filtering.
• Ultra-fast grids - Optimized for libraries with thousands of items.
• Cross-platform sync - Watch progress syncs across all your devices.

Playback:

• Web: Built-in DASH/HLS player with Picture-in-Picture and subtitle support.
• macOS: MPV-powered with HDR, Dolby Vision, and advanced audio passthrough.
• Mobile: Native players with background playback and streaming quality options.

apps.name: Flux
apps.subtitle: Connect an Omarchy computer to your phone: files, clipboard, notifications, media, camera, and more
apps.localizedDescription:
Flux:

Connect your Omarchy desktop to an Android phone, an iPhone, or a Mac over your local network, or through Tailscale when you are away. Share files, clipboard text, and clipboard images, read phone notifications, control media, and use your phone as a camera or microphone.

Flux includes a CLI, a background daemon, a native Qt window, an Omarchy shell plugin, a native Android app, a native iOS app, and a native macOS app. fluxd listens on 1 TCP port from 12100 to 12108 and on UDP port 12100, and it also opens the connections to the devices itself. So Flux works with the default Omarchy firewall, which blocks inbound traffic, and needs no new inbound rule. See security for what a paired device can do and which settings limit it.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Flux uses the camera to scan text, codes, and pages, to take photos and signatures, and to stream as a webcam to a computer.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Flux checks that it is you before your iPhone types or replies on a computer, shows the screen of a computer, or approves sudo.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Flux finds and connects to your Omarchy computers on the local network.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Flux listens while you dictate, and while you use this iPhone as a microphone for a computer.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Flux sends your new screenshots and photos to your computers when you turn that on in Settings.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Flux changes your speech to text for the computer to type. The iPhone recognizes it on the device when it has the language.

apps.localizedDescription:
Foxlations:

A manga, manhwa, light‑novel and video reader for Android and iOS with an extension‑based source system. Add sources from any site with the built‑in RepoForge generator (beta), sync progress to AniList / MyAnimeList / Kitsu, back up and restore your library, and read behind Cloudflare‑protected sites.

Please note that I do school and work full time, so updates might be slow. I do see your messages and issues — it just might take me a bit to get to them!

RepoForge is in beta. It won't always generate a correct source — check what it produces and adjust the selectors if a site doesn't come out right.

Foxlations is a reader only. It does not host any content — you add your own sources.

versions.localizedDescription:

apps.localizedDescription:
Command & Conquer Generals: Zero Hour — macOS, iOS & iPadOS:

Zero Hour running natively on Apple Silicon Macs, iPhone, and iPad — campaign, skirmish, and Generals Challenge, with touch controls built for RTS (tap-select, drag-box, long-press deselect, two-finger scroll, pinch zoom). No emulation: this is the real 2003 engine compiled for ARM64, rendering DirectX 8 → DXVK → Vulkan → MoltenVK → Metal.

Built on EA's GPL v3 source release, standing on a chain of community work — TheSuperHackers, Fighter19's original Unix port, and fbraz3/GeneralsX — this fork adds the iOS/iPadOS port and a set of engine fixes. See Lineage & credits for who built what. The original GeneralsX README lives on the upstream-main branch.

No game assets are included or distributed. You need your own copy (Steam, ~$5 on sale).

apps.localizedDescription:
Git Writer:

A minimalistic, cross-platform note-taking app that uses Git repositories to keep your Markdown notes version-controlled and synchronized across devices. Supports all major platforms (Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, iOS).

Used technologies::

• Git Integration: JGit (Desktop and Android), libgit2.
• Image & File Handling: Coil 3 & FileKit.
• Markdown parsing & rendering: multiplatform-markdown-renderer & jetbrains-markdown.

Spell Checking:

• misspellings are checked against the spell check language in the app settings, which defaults to the app language.

Package names include the region: hunspell-es and hunspell-cs, but hunspell-de-de on Debian and Ubuntu. Chinese is not spell checked, hunspell has no dictionary with word segmentation.

apps.localizedDescription:
Gotchi Galaxy:

A pixel-art pocket pet you raise, breed and take to far-away planets. Free, no account, no ads.

Choose your way to play:

• Mac (the full game, plays with friends on the same Wi-Fi).

• Unzip it and drag Gotchi Galaxy to Applications.

Android (the full game, plays with friends on the same Wi-Fi).

• Android asks to allow installs from this source: say yes once.
• New versions are offered inside the game, in Settings.

iPhone app through TestFlight (the full game, plays with friends on the same Wi-Fi).

• Install Apple's TestFlight app from the App Store.
• On your iPhone, open the Gotchi Galaxy invite, tap Accept, then Install.
• New versions arrive in TestFlight; it offers each one.

versions.localizedDescription:

apps.localizedDescription:
gramX:

Your Telegram channels as one timeline.

gramX is an Android app that shows the channels you follow on Telegram as a single feed, newest first, instead of a list of chats. Posts, comments, reactions, photos, videos and polls all read in one place, and you can still message people and post to the channels you run.

gramX is an independent app. It is not made by, affiliated with, or endorsed by Telegram.

Features:

• Channels. A page for each channel with its posts, media, files and links, plus statistics for the channels you own or manage.
• Messages. Your direct messages and groups, with replies, forwards, pins, search and scheduled messages.
• Posting. Write to the channels you run: text, photos, videos, files, polls, stickers, voice messages and locations.

versions.localizedDescription:

apps.name: Hackers
apps.subtitle: Hackers is an elegant iOS app for reading Hacker News written in Swift
apps.localizedDescription:
Hackers:

Hackers is an open-source Hacker News client for iPhone and iPad, built with SwiftUI.

It focuses on fast feed browsing, readable comment threads, voting, bookmarks, search, Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, dark mode, and a native iOS/iPadOS experience. Version 5 is a SwiftUI rebuild with a modular Swift Package layout.

Download on the App Store Join the TestFlight beta.

Features:

• Browse Top, New, Best, Ask, Show, Jobs, and Active stories.
• Read nested comments with collapse/expand controls.
• Open stories in the in-app browser with comments available alongside the page.
• Vote on posts and comments when signed in.
• Save bookmarks and search Hacker News content.
• Use the share extension to open Hacker News links in Hackers.
• Supports Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, dark mode, and high-contrast-friendly styling.

Features:

Ikemen GO aims for backwards-compatibility on par with M.U.G.E.N version 1.1 Beta, while simultaneously expanding on its features in a variety of ways.

This does not mean bug-for-bug emulation. Behavior may intentionally differ when matching M.U.G.E.N would mean preserving bugs, quirks, or unnecessarily limiting the engine.

System requirements:

A GPU supporting OpenGL 3.3, OpenGL ES 3.2 or Vulkan is required.

you need them. Intel macOS builds are not currently published.

Running:

Download the ZIP archive that matches your operating system and extract its contents to your preferred location.

On Windows, double-click Ikemen_GO.exe. On macOS or Linux, double-click Ikemen_GO.command. On Android, install ikemen-go.apk from the Android archive.

apps.name: iCSM
apps.subtitle: A personal CSGO port by BILIBILI @SU_ZeShin for iPhone and iPad, running natively on ARM64 with a Metal rendering backe…
apps.localizedDescription:
iCSM:

A personal CSGO port by BILIBILI @SU_ZeShin for iPhone and iPad, running natively on ARM64 with a Metal rendering backend. The game modules, SDL, and Metal backend are built from source. Current version: 0.7.2 (Build 200).

Features added in this port:

• MetalFX spatial upscaling: render the scene at a lower internal resolution and upscale it to the output resolution, using the scene render scale defined by the graphics presets.
• MetalFX frame interpolation: targets 60 rendered frames → 120 displayed frames, with low-latency scheduling, weapon animation protection, and adaptive behavior under load. Requires a supported GPU and a 120 Hz display; actual frame rates depend on the device and scene.

apps.name: iCTRL
apps.subtitle: AI-friendly iOS automation service, built on XCUITest
apps.localizedDescription:
iCTRL:

AI-friendly iOS automation service, built on XCUITest.

For automated testing and research only. iCTRL hands full control of a phone (taps, text input, screen contents, every installed app) to whoever holds a paired key. Any automation like this can be hijacked or misused: a leaked key, a client you shouldn't have approved, or an agent acting on instructions it picked up along the way. Weigh the risks before you use it:

• Run it only on devices you own and accounts you are entitled to automate.
• Approve only the pairing requests you started.
• Leave remote access off unless you need it, and stop the server when you are done.
• Don't leave an agent unsupervised around payments, messages or anything that can't be undone.

versions.localizedDescription:
An AI-friendly iOS/iPadOS automation service. Tell your agent "My iPhone is running iCTRL at:8200 — figure out how to drive it." and it reads the on-device manual and takes it from there. Works with any agent that can make HTTP requests: OpenClaw, Hermes, Minis, Claude Code, Codex and others.

apps.name: IKEMEN Go
apps.subtitle: IKEMEN Go M.U.G.E.N. engine ported to iOS
apps.localizedDescription:
IKEMEN Go for iOS:

Play classic M.U.G.E.N characters, stages, and screenpacks on your iOS device with native on-screen touch controls.

Features:

• Pure upstream engine — ios/engine/ is a synced copy of upstream ikemen-engine/Ikemen-GO (with only a lightweight crash-path guard and the MoltenVK config override).

• Vulkan rendering via MoltenVK — the engine's Vulkan renderer runs smoothly on Metal through MoltenVK, linked and resolved via dlsym.
• Portrait and landscape play — in landscape the fight fills the screen beneath translucent controls; in portrait the engine renders the fight in the top band and controls sit below.
• SDL2, FFmpeg, and libxmp support — robust multimedia handling for audio, background videos, and module music formats (MOD/XM/S3M/IT).
• Game controller support — MFi and GameController framework controllers work out of the box.

apps.name: iNDS
apps.subtitle: Revival of the Nintendo DS emulator for iOS.
apps.localizedDescription:
iNDS is a derivation of the previous Nintendo DS emulator apps for iOS: nds4ios and Nitrogen. The iNDS Team release of iNDS is a fork of the original iNDS emulator by William Cobb. The iNDS Team aims to create a version that is driven by support from the community, adding trusted contributors to the team over time so that pull requests and issues do not sit untouched.

Currently, emulation is powered by the DeSmuME threaded ARM interpreter and runs at nearly full speed on the iPhone 5 and above. Due to the need to mmap the entire ROM into memory, older devices with only 256MB of RAM are not supported. These devices include the iPod Touch 4, iPad 1, iPhone 3GS, and anything below those devices.

apps.name: InputLine
apps.subtitle: Stream with Moonlight, keep your Steam Controller
apps.localizedDescription:
Steam Link is the only streaming app that brings the Steam Controller across with everything Steam Input can do. Moonlight and other streaming apps only see standard gamepads, so the trackpads, gyro and back buttons are lost.

InputLine closes that gap. A small app on your iPad or iPhone reads the controller over Bluetooth and sends it straight to your PC, where Steam sees a real, wired Steam Controller. Your streaming app doesn't need to know: it streams video and audio as usual, while InputLine runs in the background.

• Everything Steam Input offers: both trackpads with pressure and haptics, gyro, the four back buttons, capacitive sticks and grips, and your per-game layouts.
• Works with any streaming app and host: Moonlight with Sunshine, Apollo or Vibepollo, unmodified.

versions.localizedDescription:
• App: faster controller pickup after a restart, and faster PC connection.
• Linux service hardening, Tailscale-only firewall option, crypto cross-check, status fix.

New Contributors:

• @Evimore made their first contribution.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: InputLine connects to your Steam Controller over Bluetooth and forwards it to your PC.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: InputLine finds your PC on the network and sends your controller's input to it.

apps.name: IW4LJ
apps.subtitle: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 (2009) multiplayer on your phone — Android and iPhone, and now Windows PC with the same…
apps.localizedDescription:
IW4LJ:

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 (2009) multiplayer on your phone — Android and iPhone, and now Windows PC with the same mod menu.

IW4LJ is a phone port of IW4L (by vladtrc), an open-source runtime for MW2 written in Rust with the Bevy engine. It is not a wrapper or an emulator: it reads the game data from a copy of MW2 you own and runs it in its own engine, with touch controls, controller support and a mod menu built for a phone. Android and iPhone players can play together over LAN and online.

You need your own copy of MW2 multiplayer. This repository contains source code only, no Activision game data. See No game files here.

Info:

jellify (verb) - to make gelatinous see also.

Jellify is a free and open source music player for the Jellyfin Media Server. Built with React Native, it is available for both iOS and Android.

Showcasing the artwork of your library, it has a user interface congruent to what the big guys do. Jellify also provides algorithmic curation of your music, driven by Jellyfin's Instant Mix and Suggestions APIs.

This app was designed with me and my dad in mind. I wanted us to have a sleek, one stop shop for live recordings of bands we like (read: the Grateful Dead). The UI was designed so that we'd find it instantly familiar and useful. CarPlay / Android Auto support was also a must for us, as we both use CarPlay religiously.

If you would like support, want to request a feature, or just talk to other JESSI users you should join the discord: https://discord.gg/aZ9HbYXKur
Basic Information
JESSI is an iOS app that runs Minecraft: Java Edition servers natively on iOS, targeting iOS 14+. JESSI runs on both jailed and jailbroken iOS, only requiring JIT to do so.
JESSI was designed specifically to be as easy to use as possible, even if you have never hosted a Minecraft server before. The UI is simple to understand and use, making JESSI the best beginner friendly option to host a minecraft server.
Tutorials for installing JESSI can be found in the wiki for this repo. More tutorials for specific features will be coming shortly, as well as video tutorials!
LiveContainer
While this repo won't directly give you a guide on how to use/install LiveContainer, it should be noted that JESSI has full compatibility with LiveContainer. All you need to do is install JESSI inside of LiveContainer, then launch it with JIT.

apps.name: Kant
apps.subtitle: Private, end-to-end encrypted messenger. No phone number, no one in the middle: messages go device to device, and relay…
apps.localizedDescription:
Kant is a free, open-source messenger with no phone number, no email address and no company server keeping a copy of your messages. They're encrypted on your device and decrypted only on the devices of the people you're talking to.

Devices behind home routers, mobile data and office firewalls can't usually reach each other directly, so a relay passes the encrypted messages between them. A relay can't read what it carries and doesn't store it. Anyone can run one: on a server, on a computer at home without opening a port, or inside the Kant desktop app itself.

Kant is in public beta and hasn't had an independent security audit yet. The threat model and kant.network/security say exactly what has been checked and what hasn't.

apps.name: Keka
apps.subtitle: The file archiver
apps.localizedDescription:
Keka is a full featured file archiver, as easy as it can be.

With Keka you can compress as many files as you want in a bunch of formats. You can also encrypt them to store and share securely and with privacy.

Keka can also browse and extract lots of compressed files, from ZIP and 7Z to RAR archives. Whether they are encrypted or encoded in with old charsets this is not a problem for Keka.

Compression formats supported: 7Z, ZIP, TAR, ZSTD, GZIP, BZIP2 and AppleArchive (AAR).

Extraction formats supported: 7Z, ZIP, RAR, TAR, GZIP, BZIP2, AAR, XZ, ZSTD, ISO, LZMA, EXE, CAB, MSI, PAX, JAR, APK, APPX, XPI, IPA, CPGZ, CPIO, XIP, CPT and many more.

apps.subtitle: Kid Pix, native on iPad. An unofficial Swift recreation for Apple Pencil and touch
apps.localizedDescription:
KidPad:

KidPad is a native recreation of the classic Kid Pix experience for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. It aims to look, sound, and behave like Kid Pix, using the familiar artwork, sounds, tools, menus, stamps, brushes, and playful interactions available through the pinned JSKidPix project.

The experience is deliberately recognizable. This is not a loosely inspired drawing app with a retro skin. KidPad's purpose is to make Kid Pix feel at home on modern Apple devices.

In one sentence: KidPad is Kid Pix for iPhone and iPad, recreated natively and released as an independent, unofficial project.

What KidPad is:

• A new native Swift implementation of the Kid Pix drawing experience.
• A Core Graphics canvas with SwiftUI and UIKit controls, not a browser canvas.

Kikoto is self-hosted software only and provides no service or content. It is designed solely for DLsite works you have purchased yourself; see the Disclaimer.

Features:

Scans, syncs, file edits, and AI tasks run as workflows you can follow in Activity, roles decide who may browse, fetch, edit, and administer, and all state lives in one SQLite database. The APK and IPA for the apps are attached.

Make speech right on your iPhone or iPad with this offline text-to-speech app. Once a model is on your device, speech is generated there too—no account or cloud service needed.

QuickStart:

• Open Speak, select the model and a preset voice, enter text, and tap Speak.

apps.subtitle: A native iOS & iPadOS client for Navidrome, built with Apple's Liquid Glass
apps.localizedDescription:
Knight Music is an open-source, native client for Navidrome and OpenSubsonic personal music streaming servers. Designed around Apple's modern Liquid Glass paradigm on iOS and iPadOS 26, it pairs fluid animations, deep system integrations, and animated Apple Music artwork with an uncompromising offline-first architecture.

Features:

• Player: Audiophile-grade playback core built on AVQueuePlayer. Provides gapless playback with advance look-ahead item preparation, dynamic ambient palette backgrounds extracted from artwork (ArtworkPalette), time-synchronized lyrics with tap-to-seek and auto-scroll, comprehensive queue manipulation (drag reordering, swipe deletion, play next/later), customizable sleep timer with gentle audio fade-out and end-of-song pause, AirPlay route picker integration, ReplayGain volume normalization (track and album modes with peak clamping), and synced star and 5-star ratings.

Lampcord:

Lampcord is a lightweight Discord client built with Compose Multiplatform for Mobile and Desktop. It aims for a native, fast, and customizable Discord experience without the bloat and heavy memory footprint of Electron or WebViews.

Inspiration:

• Aliucord: Lampcord inherits a lot of my work on Aliucord and my plugins for it.
• Nucleus: Provides proper support for Wayland.

Lampcord is in BETA.

This is still in development and may not be ready for day-to-day use.

Authentication:

• [x] Password & token login.
• [x] Remote QR code login.
• [x] Multi-account switcher.

Messaging and chat:

• [x] Markdown parsing & code highlighting.
• [x] Custom emojis, reactions & stickers.
• [x] Message replies & edit / delete.
• [x] Message pinning & thread views.
• [x] Local message deletion logger.

LANreader is an iOS/macOS(Apple silicon) manga reader for LANraragi.

The AppStore version is a paid app. You can still follow Test on your device section to install it on your device for free.

Deep links:

Other apps and shortcuts can open LANreader with links in the form lanreader://?=. Percent-encode every value.

Archive IDs come from the LANraragi server LANreader is connected to.

AltStore:

• Use AltStore Classic to install on your device.

Source Code:

• Clone this project.
• Open it in Xcode.

Use the repository commands so local development and Continuous Integration (CI) exercise the same checks:

• ./scripts/verify-changes selects the quickest safe verification tier for the current diff.
• ./scripts/verify runs repository validation, strict SwiftLint, and the complete iOS test suite.

apps.localizedDescription:
LecCheck:

Mark every lecture, practice and lab you attend, and see your semester at a glance. Fast, offline-first, and synced live between your phone and computer — for free.

Android · iPhone · Linux · (Windows coming).

LecCheck 2 is a from-scratch rebuild of LecCheck v1. v1 saved the whole app as one JSON blob and rebuilt every screen on each tap; v2 keeps a local SQLite database on every device, redraws only what changed, and syncs individual fields in the background — so it is instant, works offline, and never loses edits.

Features:

• Today — what's on now or next with a live countdown, one-tap Attended / Missed / Watched, and a "needs marking" queue (swipe right = attended, left = missed, with undo).

apps.name: LegacyPadDisplay
apps.subtitle: Built and running for real on an iPad Air (Model A1475, iOS 12.5.8), over a Lightning cable and over Wi-Fi
apps.localizedDescription:
Turn an iPad or iPhone stuck on iOS 12 into a second display for your Mac (macOS 26), over Lightning or Wi-Fi — free, self-hosted:

Built and running for real on an iPad Air (Model A1475, iOS 12.5.8), over a Lightning cable and over Wi-Fi. H.264 video, touch, two-finger scroll, and a real mouse cursor all work.

Same Wi-Fi is enough. Plug in a Lightning cable for better speed and quality: the Mac prefers USB (lower, steadier latency) and falls back to Wi-Fi when the cable is pulled.

iPhone uses the same project. Pick it as the Xcode destination. The screen is smaller, so an iPad is the useful case. Minimum iOS is 12.0 (iOS/project.yml → deploymentTarget), tested on iOS 12.5.8.

versions.localizedDescription: Unsigned IPA for iOS 12. Install with Sideloadly; see README Step 2.

apps.localizedDescription:
A standalone agent with its own model settings. The desktop app is Electron, the phone app is React Native, and the phone works on the same sessions as the computer.

This is not a shell around Claude Code or Codex. The agent loop, tools, skills, and MCP are implemented here. You bring the models, plugins, and skills.

Download:

If you are not sure which architecture you have: on macOS look at the chip line in About This Mac, on Windows look at System type under Settings → System → About, on Linux run uname -m (x86_64 is x64, aarch64 is arm64).

AppImage or deb, not both. AppImage needs no installer: chmod +x and run it on any distribution. The .deb is for Debian and Ubuntu: sudo apt install ./Lyra--amd64.deb.

apps.subtitle: Follow your Pi sessions and keep work moving from your phone
apps.localizedDescription:
About the project:

Maestro Mobile is an iOS / Android companion for Pi. Your sessions run on your computer; the app connects through a local Host service to show progress and control authorized live sessions.

• Stay informed: browse sessions, search history, and check usage, tasks and teammates.
• Keep working: send text or images, steer a running turn, queue a follow-up, switch models or stop a task.
• Make decisions: answer Ask questions and review Plans from the app when the desktop session has compatible pi-maestro-flow loaded.
• Stay connected: pair with a QR code or short code, reconnect automatically, and receive task notifications.

Available actions depend on the desktop session's permissions and capabilities. Historical sessions are read-only; new Pi sessions start on the desktop. Docker deployments provide a read-only dashboard.

apps.name: Manatan
apps.subtitle: Seamless immersion language learning for anime, manga, novels on all platforms
apps.localizedDescription:
Watch anime and YouTube. Read manga and novels. Look up words and save useful sentences without leaving the story.

One app, from immersion to review:

• Watch, read, and listen. Local videos, YouTube, manga, EPUBs, web novels, and podcasts in one app.
• Understand in context. Look up words with your imported dictionaries, use on-device manga OCR, and work with interactive subtitles.
• Keep what matters. Save sentences with audio and images where available. Review in Manatan SRS with account sync, or keep using Anki.

Your first lookup:

• Install and open Manatan. A dictionary is installed automatically.
• Open a video with subtitles, a manga chapter, or an EPUB you want to understand.
• Look up a word. Save a useful sentence to Manatan SRS or Anki, then keep going.

apps.localizedDescription:
Mangatan is an open-source desktop app for reading manga and novels, watching anime, and learning languages through dictionary lookup, OCR, subtitle mining, and Anki export.

Features include:

• Reading manga, webtoons, comics, novels, animes, movies, and more.
• Local reading of content.
• A configurable reader with multiple viewers, reading directions and other settings.
• Tracker support for anime and manga: MyAnimeList, AniList, SIMKL, trakt and Kitsu support.
• Categories to organize your library.
• Light and dark themes.
• Create backups locally to read offline or to your desired cloud service.

then download the asset that matches your platform:

• Windows — Mangatan--windows.exe (installer) or Mangatan--windows.zip (portable).
• macOS — Mangatan--macos-arm64.dmg (Apple Silicon).
• Linux — Mangatan--linux-x86_64.tar.gz.

See the desktop install guide for the full download-and-run steps on each platform.

apps.subtitle: A recomp (using the RexGlue SDK) of Minecraft Xbox 360 Edition for iOS
apps.localizedDescription:
MCX360 Edition: Minecraft: Xbox 360 Edition for iPhone:

A native iOS port of Minecraft: Xbox 360 Edition (Title Update 9), built with the ReXGlue static recompilation SDK. The Xbox 360 code is recompiled ahead of time to run natively on iPhone. Graphics run through Vulkan on Metal via MoltenVK. Developer mode MIGHT be required on older and newer iOS, enable it going trough: Settings > Privacy & Security, scroll to the bottom, toggle on Developer Mode, and restart your device.

You need your own copy of the game. This release does not include the game's data files (textures, sounds, worlds, the original default.xex). You provide them from a disc and title update you own. This project is not affiliated with Mojang, Microsoft, or 4J Studios.

apps.name: Meowstache
apps.subtitle: Your cat, your robot, your data
apps.localizedDescription:
Meowstache:

The Litter-Robot 4 is the best self-cleaning litter box around. But its maker now puts basic features behind a subscription, and owners haven't taken it well.

Subscriptions that pay for servers and new features are fine. But history older than one week, and alerts that can save your cat's life (no litter box visits, or too many), are basic features. They shouldn't be paywalled. My device. My data. This is how enshittification starts, and the Litter-Robot is heading down that path.

Meowstache is an unofficial Android app that talks to your robot and gives you:

• Full history: week, month, year and all-time charts for weight, visits and cycles. It's kept on your phone, so it outlives the server's retention.

apps.subtitle: Mi TV remote for macOS, Android and iOS: control Xiaomi TVs over Wi-Fi. MiLink protocol reverse engineered with REA
apps.localizedDescription:
Mi TV Remote:

Remote control apps for Xiaomi Mi TV (Android TV / PatchWall) on macOS, Android and iOS. They control the TV over Wi-Fi with no ADB, using a remote service built into the TV: Xiaomi's MiLink, with no pairing needed, or, on models without it, Google's Android TV remote service after a one-time pairing code.

MiLink's protocol isn't documented, so it was reverse engineered with REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) from the TV's own firmware (see How it was reverse engineered).

The macOS app opened from the menu bar (left) and the TV screen, recorded at the same time over ADB (right). Watch the MP4.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Xiaomi. "Mi" and "Xiaomi" are trademarks of their respective owners.

apps.localizedDescription:
← Back to main Moonfin project.

Moonfin is a media client for Jellyfin and Emby servers, built with Flutter. One shared codebase powers phones and tablets, Windows, macOS, and Linux, Android TV, Fire TV, and Apple TV, and the browser. It's made for people who want a modern, customizable experience on every screen they own.

Platform Support:

Android TV, Fire TV, and Apple TV ship from this same codebase with a TV-tuned interface and D-pad navigation. Fire TV runs the same native backend as Android TV. Web runs as an installable PWA through the Moonbase server plugin.

Features:

• One codebase, every screen. Phones, tablets, desktop, Android TV, Apple TV, and web, with navigation tuned for touch, pointer, and remote.

apps.localizedDescription:
Muguet (iOSVN Rebuild):

An open-source native Mach-O ARM64 port of Grand Theft Auto V for iOS, iPadOS, and macOS. Powered by WebAssembly ahead-of-time (AOT) compilation and Apple Metal graphics.

• Native ARM64 Execution (No JIT Required):.

• Ahead-of-Time (AOT) Compiled: Game bytecode is precompiled into a native Mach-O ARM64 executable segment (__GAME).
• No Debugger / Tethering Needed: Runs at full native machine speed without requiring JIT debugging entitlements, Xcode tethering, or external developer tools.
• Compatible with iOS 15.0+: Supports 64-bit iOS devices running iOS/iPadOS 15.0 or newer.

• Apple Metal Graphics & 120 FPS Activation:.

• Direct Metal Pipeline: Graphics commands route directly through Apple Metal via wgpu.
• Zero Web Overhead: Bypasses browser sandboxes, WebGPU layers, and WebKit compositor overhead, minimizing draw-call latency and memory consumption.

apps.name: Namma Wallet
apps.subtitle: Namma Wallet is an open-source Flutter mobile application for managing digital travel tickets and passes
apps.localizedDescription:
Namma Wallet:

Namma Wallet is an open-source Flutter mobile application for managing digital travel tickets and passes. It provides a unified interface to save, organise, and view tickets from multiple sources, including SMS, PDFs, QR codes, and clipboard text. The app features intelligent parsing for Indian transport providers and generates beautiful digital ticket designs. Unlike Apple Wallet or Google Wallet, which support only specific formats, Namma Wallet is a flexible, community-driven solution that works with any ticket type and format.

Multi-Source Ticket Management:

• SMS Parsing – Automatically extract tickets from TNSTC, IRCTC, and SETC SMS messages.
• PDF Processing – Parse TNSTC bus tickets from PDF files using Syncfusion PDF library.
• Image Processing - Parse District movie tickets from Images.

versions.localizedDescription:
• Added subtle haptic feedback when navigating and interacting with tickets.
• Enhanced ticket parsing with support for newer layout styles.

• Bug fixes and stability improvements.

Notes::

Apple Notes meets GitHub. A native SwiftUI iPhone app (iOS 26 and newer; targets iOS 27 automatically once the build machine has the iOS 27 SDK) for local-first notes that can be linked to files in GitHub repositories, with real commits, history, diffs, offline editing and conflict resolution.

Status: the source was written without access to Xcode, so it has not yet been compiled or run on a device. The first CI run on a macOS runner is the first real build — see Status.

The bundle is always named nbwsc-vX.Y.Z.ipa (plus a .sha256). Two ways to get it:

• compute the next version from the latest vX.Y.Z tag (patch/minor/major, or type an explicit version) and refuse to reuse a tag,.
• run the unit tests,.
• archive the app and package an .ipa,.

apps.localizedDescription:
NuggetVPN:

A fast, good-looking VPN client for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS, built with Wails v3 and React 19.

Every proxy core it can run is compiled into the app as a Go library. There is no bundled executable, nothing is downloaded at runtime, and nothing is shelled out to.

Connecting:

• Four cores to choose from (see Cores).
• Subscriptions, with data usage and expiry shown when the provider reports them. Share links (vless://, vmess://, ss:// and others), full sing-box configs, and Clash configs are all accepted.
• Proxy chains, where each hop dials through the one before it.
• Fastest server: the tunnel keeps measuring the best few servers and moves to whichever is fastest.
• Kill switch and automatic reconnect.

About Omni:

Omni is an app to manage downloads for your pyLoad instance. It is available for both Android and iOS.

This app is in beta. If you encounter a bug, check the known issues section first and create.

A pyLoad version of 0.5.0b3.dev98 or newer is required. You need to create an API key before you can add a server.

Support development:

A lot of work has gone into building this app. It is provided for free and open-source. If you like it, please consider donating to support the development. Ideally, I would like to publish the app on the App Store but for enrolling in Apple's developer program there is a fee of 99$ per year.

Features:

• Manage multiple instances.
• All views will periodically auto-refresh, no manual refreshing required.

apps.name: OmniPad
apps.subtitle: A Controller for all types of games with compatibility in some Operating System
apps.localizedDescription:
OmniPad - Universal Ultra-Low Latency Phone Gamepad:

OmniPad turns any smartphone or tablet (Android or iOS) into a tournament-grade, ultra-low latency virtual game controller for PC (Windows, Linux, and macOS).

It emulates a genuine Microsoft Xbox 360 controller (via kernel-level ViGEmBus on Windows, native /dev/uinput on Linux), Sony DualShock 4, and macOS CoreGraphics input simulation, alongside native DSU / Cemuhook motion gyro support and an automatic Keyboard & Mouse fallback for classic/strategy games.

Host Operating Systems (PC Server):

• Windows: Windows 10 & 11 (64-bit and 32-bit). Kernel-level virtual Xbox 360 and DualShock 4 controllers via ViGEmBus, low-latency WASAPI audio capture, and DXGI screen streaming.
• Linux: Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora, Arch Linux, SteamOS (Steam Deck). Zero drivers required; uses native Linux /dev/uinput for hardware-level controller, mouse, and keyboard creation.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: OmniPad uses your camera to scan the server QR code on your PC screen for instant pairing.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: OmniPad requires access to your local Wi-Fi network to discover and stream high-speed gamepad inputs (up to 250 Hz) and receive real-time haptic rumble feedback from your Windows PC.

apps.subtitle: Open-source Xray-core client for iOS, macOS, Android, Windows, and Linux. Smart routing, subscription management, and c…
apps.localizedDescription:
Bring your own servers or subscription. OneXray does not provide VPN access or proxy servers.

Why OneXray:

• Across your devices. Use iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android, Windows or Linux, with light/dark themes and five interface languages.
• Your servers, organized. Import share links, Xray JSON and subscriptions. Group manual nodes and reorder them by dragging.
• Routing you control. Choose Smart or Custom Routing, or use complete Raw and provider configurations, including Remnawave subscriptions.

Get started:

Install · Tour ·.

Contribute.

OpenAgentd is a desktop app for running a coding agent on your own machine. You give it a folder and a task. It plans, reads, edits, runs your tests, and shows you every step: each tool call with its arguments and timing, every diff, and what each turn costs. You can steer it mid-turn, review its changes before you commit, and use the models and keys you already have.

OpenTIE:

OpenTIE is an open-source reimplementation of Star Wars: TIE Fighter for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It runs the original game data natively on current systems and supports both the 1995 Collector's CD-ROM and the 1998 Windows release.

With both editions installed, OpenTIE can combine the 1995 menus, cutscenes, and adaptive iMUSE soundtrack with the 1998 flight simulation and 3D assets.

OpenTIE does not include any content from the original game. A complete installation of at least one supported edition is required. Install both editions to use the recommended combination.

Star Wars: TIE Fighter Special Edition is available from GOG and Steam.

The best of both editions:

The 1995 and 1998 releases each have their own presentation, flight simulation, and soundtrack. OpenTIE lets the menus and cutscenes, flight simulation, and music be selected independently.

OwLens:

🦉 OwLens is a professional-grade iOS cinema camera app designed for filmmakers and creators who demand uncompromising image fidelity and true control over video capture. It bypasses Apple's standard image signal processor (ISP), capturing uncompressed 14-bit RAW Bayer sensor data at full sensor resolution ($4032 \times 3024$, 12.2 MP) and encoding it directly into 10-bit HEVC Log in real time.

Key Highlights & Architecture:

• True 14-Bit Bayer RAW Capture: Bypasses Apple's ISP noise reduction, computational edge sharpening, and adaptive tone mapping. Preserves 100% of native sensor photons directly from camera hardware.
• Zero Decimation / Full Megapixels: Full $4032 \times 3024$ native Bayer data is maintained throughout capture and debayering without spatial pixel binning or CFA decimation for 4K video recording.
• Ultra-Fast Metal Compute Pipeline:.

apps.localizedDescription:
Ozen (the word means "ear") turns what the people around you say into large, steady captions on your phone, as they speak. It was built for one grandmother with hearing loss, who found every existing transcription app either unreliable with external microphones or too shallow to trust.

• Captions that hold still. Words settle in place instead of jumping around, and a name shows who is talking.
• Private by design. No account and no company server: nothing leaves the phone unless you choose to send it.
• Alerts she won't miss. The doorbell, a smoke alarm or her own name makes the phone buzz, even in a pocket; alarms flash the whole screen.
• Talk back. Type a reply and the phone says it out loud, or shows it in huge letters.

apps.name: Palettify
apps.subtitle: This is a personal repo for porting new Photographic Styles in iPhone to older model below 15
apps.localizedDescription:
Photographic Style Port:

Current version: v0.7.1.

This is an experimental tool that takes a HEIC from an iPhone older than the iPhone 16 (iPhone 15, 14, 13 … — any model whose photos match a supported tile layout) and adds the metadata an iPhone 16/17 photo carries, so that Apple Photos offers the Photographic Styles palette on it (风格 in Chinese; Apple calls the palette 调色板).

Since v0.5 it also adds the iOS 27 Texture/Grain controls (质感/颗粒) that Apple introduced with the iPhone 18 Pro. Ported photos get them as part of the port; native iPhone 16/17 photos get only these controls, and their existing image data stays byte-identical.

PeonPad does not include Warcraft II. To play, you provide data extracted from your own legally owned copy on a Mac or PC. That game content stays local to your machine and is never part of the PeonPad download.

AI disclosure: PeonPad uses substantial AI assistance for code, tests, documentation, debugging and maintenance. Some support replies and maintenance tasks are automated. There is no audited percentage of AI-generated code. Build, test and device records describe what was checked. This disclosure concerns PeonPad's workflow, not the authorship of its upstream projects.

What is PeonPad?:

PeonPad is an independent Apple-platform Warcraft II port built on the open-source Stratagus engine and Wargus game layer. It runs engine code directly on iPadOS; it does not run a Windows executable, emulate x86, or stream a game from another computer.

versions.localizedDescription:

Perfect Dark for iPhone & Apple Vision Pro:

Perfect Dark — Rare's N64 shooter — running natively on iPhone, iPad and Apple Vision Pro. Not an emulator: this is the Perfect Dark decompilation compiled for Apple silicon, through the Perfect Dark PC port and Dab's Mod, rendering on Metal.

Dab's Mod is what makes this the version worth porting: jump, a combat roll, melee combos and a third-person camera the N64 game never had, the Combat Simulator's simulant cap raised from 8 to 80, bodies that stay where they fell — and XBLA support, which draws the 2010 Xbox 360 release's high-resolution textures, meshes, rooms, font and explosions in place of the N64 art, from your own copy of that release.

apps.localizedDescription:
Phoebe:

Phoebe is a Compose Multiplatform music player for Plex, Jellyfin, Emby, Subsonic-compatible servers (Navidrome, etc.), Music Assistant, local folders, Android, iOS, desktop (JVM), and the browser (Kotlin/Wasm).

Music providers:

Phoebe can sign in to one remote music source at a time (plus optional local folders). Catalog IDs are prefixed (plex:, jellyfin:, emby:, navidrome:, music-assistant:) so items from different backends can be merged with local files in search and the library.

Support policy: Plex is the primary, best-tested integration. Jellyfin, Emby, Subsonic (Navidrome), and Music Assistant support also work, but are not my main hosting providers, so they get tested less frequently.

versions.localizedDescription: • Add Immersive library view mode.

apps.name: Phoebus
apps.subtitle: Radiant Reddit Browsing
apps.localizedDescription:
Phoebus:

Phoebus is a native iOS Reddit client that recreates the experience of.

the Apollo Reborn tweak, built entirely on Linux with xtool. It began as an attempt to rebuild Apollo's UX with modern tooling, as a standalone app, so that it can keep existing more sustainably.

• The core app is written from scratch in SwiftUI, following Apollo's design. It contains none of Apollo's code.

Phoebus is not affiliated with Apollo Reborn. It has no connection with, and is not endorsed or supported by, Apollo Reborn or its maintainers, Christian Selig or Apollo, or Reddit. Please don't contact any of them about Phoebus or ask them for help with it; open an issue in this repository instead.

Phoebus is a personal, non-commercial project. It is not sold or advertised.

apps.name: Photos Backup
apps.subtitle: PhotosBackup iOS app
apps.localizedDescription:
Photos Backup for iOS:

An experimental, fully on-device iPhone app for backing up selected photos, videos, and albums to Google Photos. It is a single SwiftUI app that completes Google account setup in an in-app web view, so everything happens on the phone without a desktop companion or hosted service.

This project uses Google's private, undocumented Photos endpoints and an Android-style authentication flow. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google, and the integration may stop working without notice. Treat it as experimental software and use it at your own risk.

What it can do:

• Connect a Google account through Google's EmbeddedSetup flow, in an in-app web view.
• Capture the single-use oauth_token in-process from the web view's cookie store.
• Exchange the token for a Google Photos credential entirely on the device.

versions.localizedDescription:
New:

• The Google Photos app now counts what this app backs up. (, thanks @saileshbro) Uploads showed as "not backed up" in the Google Photos app, and its own Free up space never offered them. It now recognises them, and its Free up space and Delete from device remove the photos from your iPhone.…

User-selected imports, saves and shares follow the chosen service settings; optional Apple models may need a download.

Available in English and 16 more localizations, including separate Spanish for Spain and Latin America.

iOS 16+ · Arabic & English · Local network transfer.

• Direct PKG transfer from iPhone/iPad to PS4.
• GAME, UPDATE, and DLC support.
• Built-in PKG library with metadata and artwork.
• Transfer queue with live progress, speed, and ETA.
• Transfer history with completed/cancelled details.
• Local file availability tracking.
• Arabic and English interface.
• PS4 connection check before sending.
• Local network transfer — PKG files are not uploaded to a cloud service.
• Designed and tested with large PKG files.

Transfer Performance:

Real-device testing was performed on an iPhone 11 Pro Max, with both the iPhone and PS4 connected over Wi-Fi.

apps.subtitle: A native Godot 4 reimplementation of the Gen 1 and 2 Game Boy Color games. Not an emulator, bring your own ROM
apps.localizedDescription:
A native Godot 4 reimplementation of the Game Boy Pokémon games. Gold, Silver, Crystal, Red, Blue and Yellow are playable from the bedroom to the Hall of Fame and their own credits. It is written from scratch in GDScript, not an emulator, static recompilation or disassembly. A user-supplied cartridge dump is SHA-1 verified, decoded once into a cache, then released. No game data ships here: bring your own ROM.

Download:

one file per platform. sha256sums.txt covers every one of them.

Nothing is signed with a paid certificate, so each platform asks once:

• Windows: More info, then Run anyway.
• macOS: right-click the app, Open, then Open again.
• Linux: chmod +x the file, then run it.
• Android: allow installing from this source.

apps.localizedDescription:
RAtouch is an Apple-platform port of the original Red Alert engine with one central goal: make a keyboard-and-mouse RTS genuinely playable by touch without redesigning the game underneath it.

Tap selects or orders. One finger drag-selects. Two fingers move the map. Pinch zooms the presentation. A hold becomes the original right-click. A slim native command deck supplies the keyboard actions and control groups an iPad otherwise lacks.

The campaigns, skirmish AI, movies, music, saves, production sidebar, hotkeys, and simulation rules remain engine-owned. RAtouch changes the platform and control layers around them.

This repository contains engine, platform code, project artwork, and one reviewed gameplay capture. It does not contain playable commercial game data. You provide legally acquired compatible data on your own device.

RemSound for iOS and macOS:

AI disclaimer: This project has been written using Claude (Fable 5, Opus 4.8 and Opus 5.5). Any usage is at your own risk and nothing can be guaranteed. Pull requests and issues are welcome.

A native companion to RemSound for iPhone, iPad and Mac: hear what RemSound computers are sending, and send your own microphone back. Built VoiceOver-first, with low-latency playback and the same end-to-end encryption as the Windows app.

It speaks the RemSound v3.x wire protocol (header version 1) and the server group protocol (header version 2), and is kept in step with the Windows app — the protocol was last reviewed against RemSound 6.1 and server-v2.16.

Features:

Audio.

• Receives both RemSound codecs: PCM 48 kHz 24-bit and Opus, including Opus forward-error-correction recovery of single lost packets.

apps.subtitle: An experimental Gecko-based web browser for iOS 13+
apps.localizedDescription:
Reynard Browser:

Reynard is a Gecko-based web browser for iOS 13+.

Unlike other browsers on iOS that are forced to use Apple's WebKit engine (including Safari and all third-party browsers), Reynard uses Gecko. This is the same engine that powers the Firefox browser on desktop and Android devices.

Besides providing an alternative, up-to-date browser engine[^1], Reynard supports Firefox add-ons, including more capable ad-blocking extensions, along with privacy features such as Enhanced Tracking Protection and DNS over HTTPS.

iOS 14 (iPhone 6S Plus, 14.1):

These sites are known to break or render incorrectly on iOS 14. The screenshots below compare how they load in Safari versus Reynard.

iOS 26 (iPhone 13 mini, 26.1):

Riffhouse is a lightweight, cross-platform music streaming client that connects to your self-hosted music server: Jellyfin, Emby, or anything that speaks the Subsonic API (Navidrome, Gonic, Airsonic and others). No subscriptions, no tracking, no ads—just your music library, your way. Stream your personal collection anywhere, offline-first caching, integrated podcasts, and built-in Android Auto support.

Perfect for: Anyone running their own music server who wants a native, feature-rich music app that works offline and feels at home on their device.

Quick Start:

• Install using the instructions below.
• Launch Riffhouse.
• Choose your server type and enter its URL (e.g., https://music.yourdomain.com)
• Log in with your account on that server.
• Start streaming your library instantly.

apps.subtitle: A web application for controlling ROS 2 robots, tailored for mobile usage
apps.localizedDescription:
Robo-Boy:

Robo-Boy is a web, desktop, iPhone, and Android interface for controlling and visualizing ROS 2 robots. It includes camera streaming, configurable control pads, 3D visualization, native time-series plotting and signal analysis, behavior-tree editing, and custom themes. All interfaces run the same React codebase and connect to a separately installed ROS stack. The mobile packages are lightweight Tauri shells; the desktop can be built either as one of those or as an Electron shell, which is larger but brings its own Chromium and so has WebRTC wherever it runs.

Start With The App:

The shortest route. The app needs only the ROS services, so there is no certificate to create and no proxy to run.

• Start the ROS services on the computer that runs ROS:.

apps.name: RustRadar
apps.subtitle: A live flight radar on a 3D globe: Tauri 2 + SvelteKit (Svelte 5) + deck.gl 9,
apps.localizedDescription:
RustRadar:

A live flight radar on a 3D globe: Tauri 2 + SvelteKit (Svelte 5) + deck.gl 9, backed by a native Rust port of the fr24 Python library.

• Every live aircraft (~20k worldwide), drawn from the real shape of its type. Around 99.7% of live traffic resolves to one of 40 aircraft models; the rest (fighters, drones, balloons, ground vehicles) keep the built-in low-poly shapes. What you see depends on the camera:.

• Flat and wide — a top-down silhouette of the actual type, which is how a map read from straight above wants to look.
• Tilted — the real mesh, about 220 triangles, enough for the planform, engines and fin.
• Zoom 11 and closer — the same mesh at about 2,600 triangles, tilted or not.

Classic iPhone OS. On your iPhone.

Slide to unlock. Open an old favorite. Make it yours again.

apps.name: ScanKit
apps.subtitle: Scan, process, OCR and organize documents — all on-device.
apps.localizedDescription:
ScanKit is a native iOS document scanner built for power users who want full control over capturing, processing and exporting their documents. Everything runs on-device; nothing leaves your iPhone or iPad unless you turn on iCloud sync.

• Smart camera: live edge detection, auto-capture, manual corner adjustment with a zoom loupe, torch, zoom, framing grid, batch/continuous scanning and a book/pair mode.
• Powerful processing: color / grayscale / black & white (adaptive binarization) / auto modes, background whitening, deskew, perspective correction, full manual adjustments and reusable presets with live preview.
• On-device OCR (Vision): searchable PDFs, copy and extract text, search by document content, Spotlight indexing.
• Flexible export: searchable + password-protected PDF, JPEG / PNG / TIFF, plain text, batch file naming, and the native share sheet (AirDrop, Mail, Files, Print, Save to Photos).
• Organized library: nested folders with colors and emoji, tags, favorites, recents, trash, grid/list views, sorting, search and bulk operations.
• Adaptive design for iPhone and iPad, with Siri/Shortcuts and Home Screen quick actions.

versions.localizedDescription:

• Scanner: Auto / Manual / Double are now always-visible buttons that switch instantly (the old hidden menu felt unresponsive). “Double” captures a book/magazine spread and splits it into two pages; picking “Auto” always works even if auto-capture wa…

Interface polish + multi-select.

• Select multiple documents right from the main library (and Recents/Favorites): a new Select button, Select All, and a count in the title, then move / tag / export / combine / delete in bulk.
• Fixed icons (the OCR text panel no longer uses a chat-bubble) and more…

apps.localizedDescription:
Folha:

Independent, on-device document scanner for iPhone. Written in Swift with SwiftUI, VisionKit, Vision, Core Image and PDFKit. Requires iOS 17 or later.

Features: multi-page capture, photo import, perspective correction, image filters, rotation, local document library, OCR and searchable PDF export.

No account, subscription, advertising service or remote document upload is implemented. Scanned documents are stored locally on the device.

On macOS with Xcode and XcodeGen installed:

The GitHub Actions workflow builds artifacts/Folha-unsigned.ipa. It does not sign or install the app and does not use Apple account credentials. Signing and device installation are separate steps handled by the user.

The included tests are available for development but are not executed by the IPA-only workflow. Camera behavior and scan quality require device testing.

apps.name: Screen Sharing
apps.subtitle: Better Screen Sharing for Apple systems
apps.localizedDescription:
Open Screen Sharing:

Open Screen Sharing aims to develop superior servers and clients based on the private protocol used by Apple VNC (macOS's Screen Sharing server and ScreenSharing.app).

iOS:

The App Store version is \$1 through October 31, 2026, then \$2. Your purchase supports my work.

The App Store version excludes the following features due to App Store restrictions:

• Apple VNC server: relies on background keep-alive mechanisms and a lockdown exploit.
• Dragging files directly from a remote Mac into other iOS/iPadOS apps: relies on a private API.

Nightly builds:

You can also switch to the Nightly track in the App settings of the macOS app and update directly.

Features:

• Compared to the original ScreenSharing.app:.

• Optimized for local networks.
• Optimized for public networks (runs smoothly with Tailscale P2P).

apps.name: Screen Stream
apps.subtitle: A modern WebDriverAgent alternative. JSON-RPC server for iOS device automation — touch, inspect, stream, control
apps.localizedDescription:
DeviceKit iOS:

Control any iOS device or simulator over a simple JSON-RPC API. Tap, swipe, stream video, inspect the UI, from any language, over localhost.

What You Can Build:

• Interactive automation — Tap, swipe, long-press, type text, press hardware buttons (home, lock, volume).
• App control — Launch, terminate, and detect the foreground app by bundle ID.
• Live screen visibility — MJPEG and H264 streaming at configurable FPS, bitrate, and quality.
• UI inspection — Full accessibility tree dumps for element targeting.
• Screenshots — PNG or JPEG capture with configurable quality.
• System control — Get/set orientation, open URLs, query screen size and scale.
• Broadcast audio/video — ReplayKit extension with H264 video and Opus audio over TCP.
• Flexible transport — JSON-RPC 2.0 over WebSocket or HTTP, from any language.

Scripta:

Minimal. Fast. Markdown-First. The modern, distraction-free note-taking experience for all your devices.

⚡ What is Scripta?:

Scripta is an open-source, local-first note-taking application designed for thinkers, writers, and developers. Built from the ground up to be lightweight, instant, and privacy-focused, Scripta gives you complete control over your notes with raw Markdown flexibility and a modern, fluid interface.

Whether you're drafting quick thoughts on your phone or organizing complex projects on your desktop, Scripta stays out of your way and lets your ideas flow.

✨ Key Features:

• 📝 Markdown-First Editor: Write in clean, standard Markdown with intelligent toolbar helpers, syntax highlighting, and an instant, fluid rendered reading view.
• ⚡ Local-First & Zero Latency: Instantaneous startup and sub-millisecond search powered by SQLite WAL. Your notes reside on your device, fully accessible offline.

Scyphomote is a dedicated remote control for Jellyfin, built with Flutter.

About:

This is a standalone port of Seanime designed to run the server in the background of Android and iOS devices.

By running the server locally (http://127.0.0.1:43211), it can serve as the backend engine for the Seanime Tenji client app, enabling torrenting, library management, and more, on your phone.

This is a highly experimental project. Stability and performance are not guaranteed.

Seanime does not provide, host, or distribute any media content. Users are responsible for obtaining media through legal means and complying with local laws.

Features:

• Full Backend: Contains the entire Seanime server running in the background.

• iOS Keep-Alive: Prevents iOS from suspending the server's connection when the app is minimized.

apps.name: Shirox
apps.subtitle: Your anime and manga library, entirely yours
apps.localizedDescription:
白 Shirox:

Your anime and manga library, entirely yours.

A free, source-available library manager for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Track what you watch and read, keep it in sync with AniList and MyAnimeList, and play it from the sources you connect.

What it is:

Shirox ships with no content of its own. It's a native SwiftUI shell around three things you bring: your tracker account (AniList or MyAnimeList), your sources (modules, a Jellyfin server, or files on your device), and your library. Everything else — progress, downloads, playback, reading — happens on your device.

Shirox does not host, provide or endorse any content.

Tracking:

• AniList and MyAnimeList side by side, with per-provider toggles for what gets written where.

• Continue Watching and Continue Reading pick up mid-episode and mid-chapter.

versions.localizedDescription: Extensions: besides Sora modules and Seanime providers, Modules now takes Stremio addons and Nuvio, Vega and SkyStream repos. apps.localizedDescription:
The Simpsons: Hit & Run — iOS Port:

An unofficial community port of The Simpsons: Hit & Run for iPhone and iPad, adapted from the Android port. Bring your own files from an owned retail PC copy of the game. Game data is not included in normal iOS builds.

Start here: Installation and game files.

Requirements:

• An arm64 iPhone or iPad running iOS/iPadOS 15 or later (the current build target).
• An iOS build installed and signed for your device. An Android APK will not work on iOS.
• The retail PC game's data files and enough free storage for them. The data is roughly 2 GB; leave additional room for transfers and saves.

apps.name: Skate It Fix
apps.subtitle: Skate It IOS fix for modern iPhones
apps.localizedDescription:
skate-it-ios-fix (WIP):

Get Skate It (EA, 2010, com.ea.skateit.inc, v1.0.70, 32-bit armv6) running on modern iPhones.

This is a copy of Applesauce, the iOS port of touchHLE / HyperHLE, with fixes the game needs and a GitHub Actions workflow that builds the iPhone app without a Mac. The Applesauce README is kept as APPLESAUCE_README.md.

Based on Applesauce ios-host at c75278b. This project isn't affiliated with or endorsed by EA, Applesauce, HyperHLE or touchHLE, and includes no games.

What's fixed:

The same fixes are proposed upstream to HyperHLE from gabe4tw/HyperHLE-Headroom-Fix (branch stack-top-headroom).

The app starts Skate It on its own instead of waiting in the library:

• Open the app. If JIT is off, it asks StikDebug to enable it (StikDebug briefly comes to the front).

apps.name: Skein
apps.subtitle: A native BitTorrent client for macOS and iOS, built with SwiftUI over
apps.localizedDescription:
Skein:

A native BitTorrent client for macOS and iOS, built with SwiftUI over libtorrent using Swift/C++ interop.

Getting started:

make on its own lists everything. make config prints the bundle id and team it resolved, which is the quickest way to check Local.env is being read.

Bundle identity and signing:

Local.env is gitignored, so a team identifier never lands in the repository. Precedence is environment, then Local.env, then the defaults in Project.swift — so CI can override a developer's checkout without editing it.

apps.name: SM64CoopDX
apps.subtitle: iOS port of sm64coopdx
apps.localizedDescription:
sm64coopdx is an online multiplayer project for the Super Mario 64 PC port that synchronizes all entities and every level for multiple players. The project was started by the Coop Deluxe Team. The purpose is to actively maintain and improve, but also continue sm64ex-coop, created by djoslin0. More features, customization, and power to the Lua API allow modders and players to enjoy Super Mario 64 more than ever!

Unlike previous multiplayer projects, this one synchronizes enemies and events. This allows players to interact with the same world at the same time.

Interestingly enough though, the goal of the project has slowly evolved over time from simply just making a Super Mario 64 multiplayer mod to constantly maintaining and improving the project (notably the Lua API.).

apps.name: Sonar
apps.subtitle: Sonar is a native SwiftUI music player for iOS 17+ and macOS 14+
apps.localizedDescription:
English overview:

Sonar is a native SwiftUI music player for iOS 17+ and macOS 14+. It supports offline local music playback (MP3, FLAC, M4A, WAV) with automatic ID3 metadata and synchronized LRC lyrics, as well as online querying through NetEase via ChKSz. QQ Music, Kugou, and other sources are temporarily hidden and disabled. Existing favorites and backups are preserved; tracks from disabled sources are marked unavailable and excluded from playback. It provides local playlists, JSON backup, synchronized lyrics, and playback queues. The Mac app combines a menu bar library with a notch player; displays without a notch use a top capsule. Both surfaces share playback and library state.

apps.subtitle: The Sonic and the Secret Rings fan-remake
apps.localizedDescription:
Project Reignition for iOS:

An iPhone and iPad port of Project Reignition, the fan remake of Sonic and the Secret Rings made with Godot 4.7 and C#. The game is built from Project Reignition's source by kumapauz with Godot's Mobile renderer on Metal, and its C# code is compiled ahead of time with .NET NativeAOT. This repository is a fork of Project Reignition with the iOS port in ios/: touch controls, iOS fixes and the build script that turns the game's source into an IPA.

The cutscene videos are not in the repository. To build, take them from Project Reignition's official PC build on GameJolt.

apps.name: Sora
apps.subtitle: A modular media player for iOS and macOS
apps.localizedDescription:
Sora:

Also known as Sulfur due to copyright considerations.

A modular media player for iOS and macOS, under the GPLv3.0 License.

Features:

• [x] macOS 12.0+ support.
• [x] iOS/iPadOS 15.0+ support.
• [x] JavaScript-based module loader.
• [x] HLS and MP4 format support with optional offline watching (via user-installed modules).
• [x] Tracking services (AniList, Trakt).
• [x] Apple Keychain support for auth tokens.
• [x] Support for personal media servers (e.g., Jellyfin, Plex).
• [x] External metadata providers (TMDB, AniList).
• [x] Background playback and Picture-in-Picture (PiP) support.
• [x] External media player support (VLC, Infuse, Outplayer, nPlayer, SenPlayer, IINA, TracyPlayer).

versions.localizedDescription:

apps.name: Spor
apps.subtitle: Modern Danish public transit companion for Android, iOS & Desktop. Real-time DSB, Metro, bus routes & platform tracking…
apps.localizedDescription:
English:

Spor is an open-source public transit app for Denmark, available on Android, iOS, and desktop (Windows / macOS / Linux).

It integrates directly with the official Rejseplanen REST API, covering nationwide passenger rail (DSB, Arriva), Copenhagen S-tog, Copenhagen Metro (M1–M4), regional and municipal buses (Movia, Midttrafik, etc.), and domestic ferries.

Features:

• Route Planning: Search journeys with departure/arrival time filters, transit mode selection, platform numbers, walking transfers, and live delay info.
• Commute Suggestions & Habit Ranking:.

• Suggests frequent and return routes based on your usual travel times, recent searches, and nearby stations.
• Ranks journey results based on your transit habits (duration, transfers, walking, Metro/S-tog/Train/Bus) and highlights the recommended route with a 1-tap Preferred order toggle.
• Tight Transfer Warnings: Highlights short or delayed connections where transfer time is tight.

apps.localizedDescription:
sqzd (squeezed):

🍋 Why "sqzd"?. Just like squeezing a piece of fruit to get the pure juice while leaving the rind behind, sqzd takes bloated videos and extracts only the concentrated, high-value information.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5a4439b4-ed05-4a95-9427-307af734a32e

sqzd is a hands-free YouTube wrapper that extracts high-signal moments from long videos. Instead of reading long summaries or manually scrubbing through timelines, sqzd does the work for you—automatically skipping the filler so you can watch just the gold.

✨ Features:

• ⏭️ Auto-Skip: No manual clicking required. The app automatically jumps to the core takeaways.
• 🎙️ Voice-Guided: A natural voice announces the topic, letting you stay informed without needing to look at your screen.
• 🎧 Background Audio: Keep listening with your screen off, fully integrated with native media controls.

apps.name: Stable Action
apps.subtitle: Samsung Super Steady Horizon Lock - rebuilt for iPhone
apps.localizedDescription:
Overview:

Samsung's Galaxy S26 Ultra ships a feature called Super Steady with Horizon Lock that keeps your footage perfectly level no matter how much you tilt or shake the phone. It's one of the most impressive stabilisation tricks in mobile cameras right now - and it was exclusive to Android.

Stable Action brings that exact same experience to iOS. Point it at anything, tilt your wrist, run, jump, ride - the horizon stays locked flat, just like on the S26 Ultra. Built entirely in native Swift, runs 100% on-device, no subscriptions, no cloud.

apps.name: SteamPhone
apps.subtitle: SteamPhone v2 - DroidDeck iOS port with the SPGB QEMU-to-Metal GPU bridge (GPL-3.0)
apps.localizedDescription:
SteamPhone (steamphone-v2):

SteamOS-style gaming on iPhone — v2 of the DroidDeck iOS port, adding the SteamPhone GPU Bridge (SPGB): a real QEMU→Metal translation layer for the local virtual machine, with an on-device harness proving the Metal side executes the protocol.

Unofficial, GPL-3.0, not affiliated with Valve or Droid-Deck. v1 lineage: this repo carries the full v1 history (custom launcher, guest image builder, Moonlight streaming skeleton, CI) and rebrands the user-facing app to SteamPhone (com.steamphone.*), version 0.2.0.

iOS apps may only touch the GPU through Metal. v1's local VM was software-rendered for that reason. v2 introduces the translation pipeline with explicit gates (full audit in gpu-rd/G0-audit.md):

Because UTM's engine runs QEMU inside the app process, the boundary is a plain C call — no IPC, no shared memory, no kernel interfaces.

apps.name: Stickman Jumper
apps.subtitle: 2D side-view base-jumping game for Android and iOS (Unity 6)
apps.localizedDescription:
Skyline Jumper:

A 2D side-view base-jumping game for Android and iOS, made with Unity 6.

Walk back, take a run-up, jump off the roof, free-fall, open the parachute at the right moment and land as close to the flag as you can — before the time runs out. One-touch controls, landscape screen.

Status: prototype, stage 1 — the core mechanics. The working title in code is StickmanJumper.

Features:

• One-tap controls: tap to walk back, tap to run, tap to jump, tap to open the parachute (a tap under the canopy cuts it away).
• Flight physics: run-up speed, jump, free fall with a speed limit, a parachute that brakes hard and drifts with the wind, soft landing only under the canopy. All numbers live in ScriptableObject configs (src/Assets/_Game/Config), no magic numbers in gameplay code.

apps.name: Stickreate
apps.subtitle: Create static and animated WhatsApp stickers on iPhone. SwiftUI + Liquid Glass
apps.localizedDescription:
Stickreate:

A native iPhone app to create static and animated WhatsApp stickers quickly, with automatic background removal. Built with SwiftUI and Apple's Liquid Glass design language (iOS 26).

Stickers follow WhatsApp's rules exactly:

• 512 × 512 px, transparent background, no white border.
• static packs 3–30, ≤ 100 KB each.
• animated packs 3–30, ≤ 500 KB each, ≤ 10 s total, ≥ 8 ms per frame.
• never mixing static and animated stickers in one pack.
• tray icon 96 × 96 PNG, ≤ 50 KB.

Build:

The Xcode project is generated, never committed. project.yml is the source of truth.

Requires Xcode 26 (iOS 26 SDK) and a deployment target of iOS 26.0.

A native iPhone and iPad port of SEGA Superstars Tennis (Xbox 360, 2008), built by statically recompiling the original PowerPC code to arm64 with ReXGlue. Graphics run through Vulkan on Metal using MoltenVK. Based on Sega Superstars Tennis ReMatch by m1ndcrap.

You need your own copy of the Xbox 360 game. Game assets and disc images are not included.

If you want to support me and remain up-to-date about this and other projects, you can in different ways:

Ko-Fi: https://ko-fi.com/dev_zer0

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@develop_erZ

Features:

• Direct Xbox 360 ISO/XISO loading, without extracting the disc.
• Support for extracted game files.
• Matches at up to 60 FPS on recent iPhones, capped at 60.
• On-screen touch controls and controller support (MFi, Xbox, PlayStation).

apps.localizedDescription:
Sweet Lyrics for iOS:

Word-by-word lyrics for whatever you're playing on Spotify, in an Apple Music style player on your iPhone or iPad.

It's an unofficial iOS version of Spicy Lyrics, the popular Spicetify extension for Spotify on desktop. Made by sppq (GitHub), tested by nie4ick.

Heads up: it works, but it's still early. You can use it every day, but expect some bugs and settings that change between versions. If something breaks, please.

apps.subtitle: iOS app (SwiftUI + CoreBluetooth) to read and change Halcyon Symbios dive computer settings over BLE — reverse-engineer…
apps.localizedDescription:
Symbios Settings — iOS app:

An independent iOS app (SwiftUI + CoreBluetooth) to read and change the settings of the Halcyon Symbios dive computer, based on the reverse-engineered BLE protocol.

⚠️ Reverse-engineered (no official spec). Most settings have been verified on-device, and every write is read back for confirmation. Still — this is a dive computer: always confirm changed settings on the device itself before diving.

Features:

• Connect over BLE, read device info (serial, firmware, battery, pressure).
• Read and display all anchored settings, grouped (Dive profile · CCR/FSP · Timeouts & alarms · Displays · Computer settings).
• Change settings via a safe read-modify-write (fetch fresh → patch one byte → SET_SETTINGS → verify with a re-read).

versions.localizedDescription: Fixes dive numbering after merging: a session now counts as a single dive, so the dives after it renumber automatically instead of leaving a gap.

SymbOS:

Tap + to install a .sis or .sisx file and it lands on the home screen next to your phone's own apps. Put any Symbian app on the real iPhone Home Screen or in the Mac's Applications folder and Dock; tapping it opens straight into that app, the way Parallels runs Windows apps on a Mac. SymbOS is built on the open-source EKA2L1 emulator and its iOS port.

Website and downloads: https://harkhowalia-1.github.io/SymbOS (published by .github/workflows/pages.yml).

apps.localizedDescription:
tensaiasobi:

give your kids something to do.

A modern, lightning-fast static web app designed for young children (ages 3-8). This project provides quick, educational, and fun mini-games perfect for short bursts of playtime, like waiting at a restaurant.

Live Demo: [Insert GitHub Pages Link Here].

🎯 Project Goals:

• Instant Load & Performance: Powered by Vite and React for snappy state transitions and rendering.
• Progress Tracking: Saves game settings and the child's streaks/milestones locally on the device using localStorage.
• Kid-Friendly UX: Mobile-first, massive tap targets, intuitive interactions, and strictly positive feedback loops (no "Game Over" screens).
• Restaurant-Safe: Muted by default. Relies on visual feedback (confetti, screen flashes, emojis) instead of sound effects.

🛠️ Tech Stack:

• Bundler & Tooling: Vite (Fast, optimized production builds for GitHub Pages).

apps.name: Tethercam
apps.subtitle: Use your iPhone as a webcam on Windows over USB, at full resolution. Free, open source (GPL-3.0), clean-room
apps.localizedDescription:
Tethercam:

Use your iPhone as a webcam on Windows 11 or Linux, over a USB cable, at up to 4K. Free and open source.

Project page →.

Tethercam turns an iPhone into a standard Windows webcam that Teams, Zoom, OBS, Streamlabs, browsers and the Camera app can use. No account, no watermark, no overlays: plug in the cable, open the app, pick Tethercam (Windows Virtual Camera). Optionally, pair once over the cable and use it over Wi-Fi.

Status: beta. Works end to end with a real iPhone 15 Pro Max: 1080p30/60 and 4K30 through the Windows camera stack, ~100 ms glass-to-glass latency at 1080p30, hardware encode and decode. See MILESTONES.md for what's still open.

Get started:

• PC: install Apple Devices from the Microsoft Store, then the latest Tethercam--x64.msi from.

versions.localizedDescription: Windows: install the MSI (needs Windows 11 and the Apple Devices app). Linux: install the .deb for your Ubuntu release or the .rpm for Fedora (needs v4l2loopback; see docs/USER_GUIDE.md). iPhone: add the AltStore source https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kshitizwagle/tethercam/main/altstore/source.j…

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Tethercam streams your camera to your PC over the USB cable, or over Wi-Fi to PCs you paired.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: With Wireless on, Tethercam lets PCs you paired over USB find your iPhone and receive its camera over Wi-Fi.
