apps.name: The Simpsons Game
apps.subtitle: A recomp of the The Simpsons Game (2007) from the Xbox 360 using RexGlue for iOS
apps.localizedDescription:
The Simpsons Game for iOS:

A native iPhone and iPad port of The Simpsons Game (Xbox 360, 2007), built by statically recompiling the original PowerPC code to arm64 with ReXGlue. Graphics run through Vulkan on Metal using MoltenVK.

You need your own copy of the Xbox 360 game. Game assets and disc images are not included.

If you want to support me and remain up-to-date about this and other projects, you can in different ways:

Ko-Fi: https://ko-fi.com/dev_zer0

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@develop_erZ

Features:

• Direct Xbox 360 ISO/XISO loading, without extracting the disc.
• Support for extracted game files.
• On-screen touch controls and controller support.
• Optional 60 FPS gameplay with the community Havok physics fix.
• Pause and resume when switching apps or locking the phone.

versions.localizedDescription: First release, the port has got enhanced improvements, that's why it's release got delayed.

apps.name: The Tanuki's Stash
apps.subtitle: Open source e621 client for iOS built with SwiftUI
apps.localizedDescription:
The Tanuki's Stash:

The worlds first e621 client for iOS, iPadOS, and macOS built with SwiftUI.

Pushing a tag beginning with v builds an iOS release IPA and publishes it to GitHub Releases. The IPA is unsigned and must be signed with your own provisioning profile before installation.

Features:

• Infinite scrolling.
• Post details page.
• Search for tags.
• Supports most media formats.

iPadOS Screenshots:

This project was inspired by The Wolf's Stash, an e621 client over on the Android side.

versions.localizedDescription: • Tanuki's Stash ver. 0.4.5.

apps.name: The Wanderer+
apps.subtitle: Single-player cheats with a mod menu: stats, combat, crafting, item spawner.
apps.localizedDescription:
The Wanderer: Post-Nuclear RPG with the Accretion mod menu built in (tap the floating button).

Work on any phone, no JIT needed:
• Health, hunger, thirst, morale never drop
• Lockpicks never break
• Spawn an item: a list of the game's 145 items with an amount slider
• Give a random item / weapon every 10 s
• Player, pet and companion take no damage
• Enemies deal no damage, player always crits, enemies never heal
• Weapon damage ×1-20
• No radiation damage
• Items never wear out
• Unlimited skill points
• Pet never hungry, thirsty or hurt
• Keep screen awake

Needs JIT, marked (JIT) otherwise:
• Crafting uses no materials

Nothing the game sells is touched: caps, tokens, bag upgrades, fuel, fast travel, revives, supply drops and experience boosts stay as they are. Single-player only.

Hooks are checked against The Wanderer 10.1; on other versions missing ones stay off. Installs next to the original app.

apps.name: Tolkara
apps.subtitle: Tolkara runs unmodified arm64 macOS applications on an iPad, with
apps.localizedDescription:
Tolkara:

Tolkara runs unmodified arm64 macOS applications on an iPad, with experimental iPhone support. It loads the original executable as data, executes its instructions natively on the device's Apple silicon, and translates the macOS API calls it makes (AppKit, Metal, CoreAudio, Carbon, Security, …) into their iOS/iPadOS equivalents.

It follows the model of Wine and Valve's Proton: the program is not ported or patched, and its executable is never modified or re-signed. Only the operating-system calls underneath it are translated. The application's own code, logic, assets and network protocol are left exactly as the vendor shipped them.

Tolkara is a do-it-yourself developer project. You build it yourself.

versions.localizedDescription:
Tolkara 0.2.1: WoW water on the iPad, older iPhones, easier setup.

World of Warcraft Forever's water no longer renders black on the iPad. The iPad hides its GPU from the I/O Registry, so the game took it for an AMD GPU; Tolkara now describes the GPU as a Mac with Apple silicon does (--native-gpu-i…

apps.subtitle: Safari extension to add torrent and magnet links to your torrent server
apps.localizedDescription:
Torrent Control for Safari:

A Safari Web Extension port of Mika-/torrent-control for macOS and iOS/iPadOS. Send magnet links and .torrent files to a remote BitTorrent client (qBittorrent, Transmission, Deluge, and others) right from Safari.

Based on torrent-control 0.2.48. See Updating from upstream.

Features:

• Add magnets and .torrent files to your torrent client without leaving Safari.
• macOS: right-click a link → Torrent Control → add (with label / server / paused / advanced options), or auto-add on click via Catch torrent URLs.
• iOS/iPadOS: tap a magnet or .torrent link → a native bottom-sheet picker (choose label, server, paused).

Option A — Sideload the iOS .ipa:

SideStore or Sideloadly using your own Apple ID (they re-sign it for you). Then enable the extension in Safari as above.

apps.subtitle: Landing page, with a live demo of the planner
apps.localizedDescription:
Tour Planner:

Landing page, with a live demo of the planner.

Photograph a DPD scanner's stop list; get the fastest delivery order, grouped into park-and-walk stops, with loading numbers and one-tap navigation. The phone app (Expo / React Native, iPhone and Android) and a web app both use one self-hosted backend on a home PC, reached privately over Tailscale.

The Android build with a sample tour (made-up names on Cologne streets); on iOS the map is Apple Maps.

The opening animation and the icon, "Delivered road": light, dark and tinted on iOS, adaptive and themed on Android.

apps.name: Trop
apps.subtitle: YouTube Music client for iOS
apps.localizedDescription:
Trop:

A free and open source YouTube Music client for iOS.

Features:

• No ads.

• Stream songs and videos from YouTube Music.
• Synced lyrics (Musixmatch, Netease, Kugou, LRCLIB, Genius).
• Library sync (playlists, albums, artists, podcasts).

• Custom app icons and themes.
• Queue management and listening history.

Add the Trop source, then install the latest stable release (unsigned - your client re-signs it with your Apple ID):

Note: AltStore PAL is not supported.

Manual Installation:

To build an unsigned IPA locally, run ./build_ipa.sh; the output is build/Trop.ipa.

Notable mentions:

• InnerTubeX - eXtended InnerTube API library for Kotlin.
• zemer-cipher - YouTube cipher deobfuscation and PoToken generation.
• Metrolist - YouTube Music client for Android.

apps.name: Tsumiru
apps.subtitle: A manga and webtoon reader for your Suwayomi server
apps.localizedDescription:
Tsumiru (積みる) takes the 積, "pile up", from tsundoku (積ん読), the Japanese habit of buying books faster than you can read them. It swaps the "read" for miru, "to look".

Features:

• Webtoon reader. Chapters scroll into each other, and pinch-to-zoom keeps working mid-scroll.
• Guided setup. The first launch looks for your server on the local network and connects to it.
• Incognito mode. Read without adding to your history. Library categories can be hidden too.
• Themes. 13 built-in themes, a custom accent colour and a pure black mode for OLED screens.
• Server login. Supports the server's simple_login and ui_login modes and keeps credentials in the device's secure storage.

Download:

• iOS: the build is unsigned, so it has to be sideloaded.

apps.name: Tsuzuri
apps.subtitle: A quiet, lightweight, completely offline, cross-platform Markdown document reader and editor built with Flutter and Dart
apps.localizedDescription:
Tsuzuri v2 (綴り):

A quiet, lightweight, completely offline, cross-platform Markdown document reader and editor built with Flutter and Dart.

What is Tsuzuri v2?:

Tsuzuri v2 is the next-generation rewrite of Tsuzuri, evolving from the original desktop-focused Tauri 2 + Rust implementation into a high-performance, single-codebase Flutter application.

While Tsuzuri v1 established the reader-first philosophy and AMOLED aesthetic on desktop, v2 expands that vision to first-class mobile hardware (Android & iOS) and the Web while preserving native desktop performance, offline independence, and typographic fidelity.

Desktop Reading Experience:

Mutually exclusive formatted view designed for long reading sessions with true #000000 AMOLED dark canvas and #FCFCFC light canvas.

Mobile Hardware Showcase:

Typeset mathematics, chemical equations (\ce{2H2 + O2 -> 2H2O}), SVG Mermaid diagrams, and structured code cards running 100% offline on mobile hardware (Realme 1 / Android 9).

TwitchPlusK is a tweak for the official Twitch iOS app. It keeps the native app and adds a fully customizable chat, 7TV/BTTV/FFZ emotes, adblock, Channel Points Auto Claim, OLED mode and more.

Available in ENGLISH and FRENCH from the Settings menu.

Chat and emotes:

• Supports favorites, animated emotes, Zero-Width emotes, replies, and threads.

Ad blocking:

• Includes two different AdBlock methods:.

• Proxy — uses a default or custom video proxy.
• Local (VAFT) — uses a local ad-blocking engine without a video proxy.

App customization:

• Adds OLED Mode, launch screen controls, Stories hiding, Live Feed continuity, Orientation Lock, and more.
• Includes settings export/import, automatic Channel Points Auto Claim, and more.

apps.name: ULTRAKILL
apps.subtitle: Runs the retail Steam build of ULTRAKILL on iOS
apps.localizedDescription:
Runs the retail Steam build of ULTRAKILL on iOS. Instead of rebuilding the game from a decompiled project, it takes the game's own data and runs it in an IL2CPP player built with the same Unity version (2022.3.29f1):

• tools/convert_data.py – converts the Windows data for iOS: every DX11 shader is translated to Metal with Unity's HLSLcc (tools/hlslcc_cli), and every file is re-tagged as an iOS build.
• tools/package_ipa.py – merges the shell IPA and the converted data into ULTRAKILL.ipa.

one-time: build the HLSLcc translator (Visual Studio 2022 + CMake):

python tools/convert_data.py --game "C:/Program Files (x86)/Steam/steamapps/common/ULTRAKILL" --out work.

apps.name: Unbill
apps.subtitle: Offline-first bill splitting for small trusted groups
apps.localizedDescription:
Unbill:

Unbill keeps shared expense ledgers on member devices and syncs them peer-to-peer. There is no hosted source of truth, hosted account system, or telemetry surface. The app records who paid and who owes whom. It does not move money.

Unbill is meant for households, trips, couples, and other small groups that already trust each other. It is not a payment network, bank integration layer, general accounting package, or product for hostile or anonymous groups.

Why Unbill:

• Your data stays on your devices. Ledgers sync directly between group members — no cloud account required.
• Works offline. Record expenses without a network. Changes merge automatically when devices reconnect.
• Runs everywhere. Desktop app, a native Apple app for iPhone/iPad/Mac, CLI, TUI, Android, and a self-hosted relay server.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: unbill uses Bluetooth to discover nearby devices and sync your ledgers.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: unbill uses the camera to scan invitation QR codes.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: unbill syncs your ledgers directly between your devices over the local network.

apps.localizedDescription:
UniSSH:

A cross-platform SSH client with end-to-end-encrypted vaults — local-first, and optionally synced through a server you host.

Your keys, your hosts, your machine. The client is complete on its own — no account, no cloud, no server required. Run one only when you want the same vault on a second device or in a team, and even then it can't read a single byte of your data.

Quick Start:

(A) is the whole install. Download the client and open it: the first run creates a local vault, and your hosts and keys are encrypted on that device. No account to create, no backend to stand up, and nothing of ours between you and the machines you connect to. (Do write down the Secret Key it shows you — it is what recovers the vault.).

apps.subtitle: Touch-enabled Fallout 2 for iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
VaultPad does not include Fallout 2 or any Bethesda, ZeniMax, or Microsoft assets. You need data from a legally purchased copy. Import happens locally; VaultPad does not download or upload your game files.

AI disclosure: VaultPad uses substantial AI assistance for code, tests, documentation, debugging and maintenance. Some support replies and maintenance tasks are automated. There is no audited percentage of AI-generated code. Build, test and device records describe what was checked. This disclosure concerns VaultPad's workflow, not the authorship of its upstream projects.

Built for fingers. Faithful to Fallout 2.:

Fallout 2 Community Edition makes the game portable. VaultPad makes it playable by touch. Instead of asking every finger movement to impersonate a mouse, VaultPad turns the actions you need into clear, persistent choices.

versions.localizedDescription:
VaultPad Developer Preview 1 for iPadOS 15 or newer.

• Unsigned arm64 IPA for self-signing and sideloading.
• No Fallout 2 game data included; import data from a legally purchased copy on first launch.
• SHA-256 checksum included.

This is not an App Store, TestFlight, or pre-signed build.

Velunivo:

Your route. Your riding speed.

An iOS-first navigator and route planner for e-scooters and e-bikes. Compare bicycle and car-road candidates, estimate travel time for the vehicle you actually ride, and plan on a fullscreen map with floating controls. Built with Expo and React Native for iPhone, iPad, Android and web.

Built around your ride:

Scheduled ETAs exclude traffic conditions and traffic simulation. An optional current traffic overlay does not change the ETA. Battery use is an estimate based on range, speed and available elevation; Bluetooth battery percentage is a separate actual reading.

Grand Theft Auto: Vice City Stories, the 2006 PSP game, made to play like a PC GTA. You get mouse look and mouse aiming, WASD, controls that change between walking, driving and flying, an HD texture pack, real-time shadows, shaded water and rain-soaked roads, and a GTA-style menu. The game's tutorial messages name your keys instead of PSP buttons.

It runs on Windows, macOS, Android and iOS. Bring your own copy of the game: no game files are included.

Voxline:

Subtitle transcription, translation, and proofreading workstation for macOS and iOS.

Native SwiftUI · WhisperKit · Apple Translation · Hard & Soft Subtitle Export · iCloud Sync.

Overview:

Voxline is a subtitle tool built natively with SwiftUI, focused on Apple native texture and system-level capabilities.

It supports a complete end-to-end on-device processing workflow: local media import, on-device WhisperKit Core ML speech recognition, Apple native offline translation, synchronized bilingual proofreading, and native subtitle/video packaging and export.

Features:

• 📂 Batch Media Pipeline — Multi-file local media queue (MP4, MOV, M4V, M4A, MP3, WAV); automatically inspects container formats, durations, file sizes, and audio tracks.
• 🎙️ On-Device WhisperKit Transcription — Native integration of WhisperKit with Core ML hardware acceleration, supporting Tiny, Base, Small, Large v3, and Turbo models.

apps.name: Waypage
apps.subtitle: Save a web page to your phone and read it with no connection: on a plane,
apps.localizedDescription:
Waypage:

Save a web page to your phone and read it with no connection: on a plane, in a tunnel, anywhere. Text is kept whole, images keep a small preview with a link to the full size, and videos keep a thumbnail that plays when you're back online. Every saved page links back to the original.

Plain HTML, CSS and JS with no build step and no dependencies. The same files run in a browser (GitHub Pages) and, wrapped by Capacitor, as the Android and iOS apps.

Status: saving and reading work: paste a link, read it offline. Sharing to the app from other apps is next (see TODO.md).

Run it:

node server.js (or double-click start.cmd on Windows) and open.

versions.localizedDescription:
Added:

• Clips' minutes and minutes left go by your own reading pace. Waypage measures the words you read by eye (not read aloud) against the time they take, over the last 30 days and across your synced devices, and shows it at the bottom of the Reading place. Until it has seen about 2,000 words,…

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Waypage uses the camera to read the sync setup code from your other device.

User guide · @suversal on X.

WrapPin sets a fixed location or moves along a walking or driving route on an iPhone running iOS 27 or newer, without a jailbreak and without installing a MITM root certificate. It uses the iOS developer location simulation service. The app interface is available in English and Simplified Chinese and follows the system language.

Use WrapPin only on devices you own and control. Do not use it to deceive other people, fabricate evidence, bypass security restrictions, or break the rules of third-party services.

What you need:

This guide uses the free route: iLoader + SideStore + LocalDevVPN + WrapPin.

• A physical iPhone running iOS 27 or newer, with a passcode set.
• A Mac, Windows or Linux computer. It is needed only once, to install SideStore.

yaabsa:

An unofficial cross-platform app for Audiobookshelf.

apps.subtitle: Modern OpenWrt & LuCI Router Manager
apps.localizedDescription:
YALA (Yet Another LuCI App):

YALA (Yet Another LuCI App) is an open-source mobile client for managing OpenWrt routers. It connects directly to your router using LuCI JSON-RPC, ubus, and standard OpenWrt system services, allowing you to monitor real-time bandwidth, manage connected devices, run network diagnostics, configure wireless radios, manage AdGuard Home DNS sinkhole, monitor VPN tunnels (WireGuard, OpenVPN, Tailscale), control Smart Queue Management (SQM/QoS), inspect storage, and update packages directly from your phone or tablet.

YALA is purpose-built for mobile, tablet, and touch-first form factors:

• Smartphones: Android (Android 8.0 Oreo up to Android 15/16) and Apple iPhone (iOS 14.0+).
• Tablets & iPads: Android Tablets and Apple iPads with dedicated wide-screen multi-column layouts and adaptive split views.

apps.localizedDescription:
YouTube Downloader:

A cross-platform video downloader. On Windows and Linux it's a desktop GUI (and CLI) wrapping yt-dlp and FFmpeg. On Android and iPhone/iPad it's a native app that does YouTube extraction in pure C# (mobile OSes can't run yt-dlp/ffmpeg as subprocesses). Every version can search YouTube, so you don't need a link.

Features:

• YouTube-themed dark UI built with Avalonia.

• Paste a URL and fetch video info (title, channel, duration, thumbnail), with Copy link and Copy player link buttons.
• Player page: a web page that plays just the video in any browser, remembers your place and follows re-uploads.

• Custom filename and save location.
• Live progress bar showing size, speed, and ETA.
• Auto-updates yt-dlp on startup.
• Supports cookies.txt for age-restricted videos.

apps.subtitle: zanzibarr streams NZB content from Usenet without downloading — instant start, true seek, PAR2 repair, Dolby Vision. Wi…
apps.localizedDescription:
zanzibarr turns Usenet into your personal streaming library. Point it at any .nzb and the video starts playing in seconds — no download queue, no waiting for the full file, no disk space sacrificed. Scrub to the final scene of a 4K remux before the first act would have finished downloading. It feels like magic; it's really just a very disciplined engine.

Why zanzibarr is different:

Play instantly, never download The Rust engine maps every seek position to the exact Usenet segments that hold it, fetches only those, decodes yEnc on the fly and serves the result through a lazy, range-aware local stream. Pause the player and the network goes quiet. Close the app and nothing is left behind on your disk.

versions.localizedDescription:

Stream anything from Usenet. Own nothing. Wait for nothing. zanzibarr plays NZB content without downloading it — instant start, frame-accurate seek, and nothing left behind on your disk.
